text:
Alex K: quick check — I'm wiring up a per-customer feature flag to enable `new-scheduler` for one enterprise customer (Acme Corp). Requirements: allowlist the tenant, verify contract id on requests, and provide a VIP override for support team. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234. Can someone confirm the gating semantics and a sane canary plan?

Maria P: can we confirm the contract-id format we should check against? ACME sometimes uses both ACME-ENT-2024 and ACME-ENT-2024-V2 in contracts. Also need audit events when the flag is evaluated.

Samir D: suggest we enforce a contract-id prefix match (startsWith "ACME-ENT-") + explicit allowlist for tenant slug. That prevents accidental rollout to other Acme environments. Also add a `vip_override` boolean checked by a separate auth role. Example flag payload we can use in the runtime: 
```json
{
  "flag": "new_scheduler",
  "scope": "customer",
  "allowlist": ["acme-corp"],
  "contract_ids": ["ACME-ENT-2024"],
  "vip_override": true,
  "canary": {"accounts": ["acme-qc"], "pct": 2}
}
```

Zara L: +1 on audit events. Also we should prevent the VIP override from bypassing contract gating entirely — it should require an explicit support role claim, and we should log who did it. Add a feature toggle change event to the customer audit stream.

Jess (oncall): heads up — when you flip for Acme, watch request volume to the scheduler path. Their integration can fan out >1k requests/min which affects tail latency. Recommend staging the canary to 3 accounts first, wait 15 min, then open to 2% traffic. Also add a fallback route in the runtime if scheduler times out: `fallback: "legacy_scheduler"`.

Alex K: thanks — I'll update the PR to: 1) use prefix matching for contract ids, 2) add audit events for flag evals and VIP actions, 3) change canary plan to 3 accounts -> 15m -> 2% -> 30m. Will also include the fallback.

preflight status: PASS :white_check_mark:

Maria P: small nit — contract id list should be stored as normalized uppercase in config and in runtime checks to avoid casing bugs. After Alex updates, I can review and merge. :thumbsup:

Alex K: will push the changes in ~30m and ping here when done. Thanks all!
